contract.run: run() -> int. init_db; data dir = parent of health_db.DB_PATH. withings_access_token(data_dir) is None -> prints 'not connected', returns 0 (no device is not a failure). Otherwise fetches the WHOLE Withings history and mirrors it into bp_readings (upsert by measured_at; readings absent from Withings are deleted — the owner deletes failed readings in the app). An empty answer while bp_readings is non-empty raises WithingsError instead of wiping. Then rewrites daily_metrics.bp_systolic/bp_diastolic as the mean of all readings of the local day (region timezone) and raw bp_systolic_max/bp_diastolic_max as the day peak, marked raw.bp_source='withings'; from the first Withings day on, a day without readings is cleared. Returns 0. WithingsError propagates to the script entry, which prints the reason, writes notify.fault (person_key=None) and exits 1.
contract.limits: Owner decision 06.10: when Withings is connected it is the only writer of daily blood pressure; metrics_db.upsert_metrics_from_json keeps Apple Health pressure only as raw.apple_health_bp witness while bp_readings is non-empty. Days before the first Withings reading keep their Apple Health values. Day = region timezone, not the timezone of the place of measurement.
